meaning: Metaphysics IV.7, 1012a2-5, reading B, analysed: given truth-apt thought affirms or denies, truth by composition, and that every proposition can be affirmed or denied in thought, bivalence of thought (every object of thought is judged truly or falsely) holds exactly when excluded middle does. Composes ARIST-MET-1012A-TRUTH-APT-THOUGHT-DECIDES-ITS-OBJECT. Constructive in both directions. Consequence for the comparison: on reading B the thought argument's premise is excluded middle restated for thought, so it begs the question against the intuitionist withholder rather than refuting him. No refutes relation is recorded.
